claims: The 98th Academy Awards take place on March 15, 2026.
The 98th Academy Awards honor 2025 films.
"Sinners" received a record 16 nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
"Frankenstein" received nine nominations for the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler directed "Sinners".
Guillermo del Toro directed "Frankenstein".
Netflix produced "Frankenstein".
Jacob Elordi has an acting nomination for "Frankenstein" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Brad Pitt stars in "F1".
Chloé Zhao directed "Hamnet".
Josh Safdie directed "Marty Supreme".
"Sentimental Value" is a Norwegian film.
Yorgos Lanthimos directed "Bugonia".
Emma Stone stars in "Bugonia".
Renate Reinsve is a Best Actress nominee for "Sentimental Value" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Emma Stone is a Best Actress nominee for "Bugonia" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Jacob Elordi is a supporting role nominee for "Frankenstein" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Benicio Del Toro is a supporting role nominee for "One Battle After Another" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Amy Madigan is a supporting role nominee for "Weapons" for the 98th Academy Awards.
Wunmi Mosaku is a supporting role nominee for "Sinners" for the 98th Academy Awards.

The Best Director nominees for the 98th Academy Awards include Chloé Zhao ("Hamnet"), Josh Safdie ("Marty Supreme"), Paul Thomas Anderson ("One Battle After Another"), Joachim Trier ("Sentimental Value"), and Ryan Coogler ("Sinners").
The Animated Feature nominees for the 98th Academy Awards include Zootopia 2, Elio, and Arco.
The 98th Academy Awards ceremony takes place at the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood.
Best Picture nominees for the 98th Academy Awards include Bugonia, F1, Hamnet, Marty Supreme, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value, and Train Dreams.
